reading: Coaching sits between filming, which already happens, and skill, which nobody measures. The retrieved evidence gives a way to measure skill (blinded rating of edited videos) and a rough size of change, but warns that residents who choose coaching differ from those who do not. Trust decides participation: residents accept filming for coaching, not for assessment.

nodes.label: Monthly video review coaching
nodes.detail: Voluntary; one consultant, one video, about 45 minutes.

nodes.label: Self-selection into coaching
nodes.detail: Coached residents start with higher scores (claim c1).

summary: Map links voluntary coaching to a blinded skill score and marks self-selection as the main threat.
